registry_info.description: The Void's workers as one being at many stages: the worker ladder of the playground plan.

worker_being.name: Worker being
worker_being.description: One being, a body per stage of the spine. Like the biome ladder (biome_object), the stage's words decide which parts stand and the seed decides the body plan whatever the stage: at Point_One the heart alone - the biome's black seed point - then rods to four feet, a face, a polyhedron carapace and solid legs with knees and joints, an ornament, a breath; at Transformation hinges, golden segments and a carried cube; at Colour its hue, a lamp, a band, painted feet; at Forces planted feet, springs and a push bar; then a gait, a sampled plan, a noise or rule-30 skin, recursive toes, antennae and a sapling grown by rewriting, eyes; a soft belly, a fused skin; the graphite-and-brass finish of the head crab at the end of the walk. The bench: commons/testing/probe_worker_ladder.tscn, gallery /worker-ladder.
